bullets.text: The Aldan House collapse destroyed Aldan House and its east wing; a warning was issued for Cobbett Row; service at the building was disrupted.
Injuries were reported in Nerridge; Nerridge fire service reported rescues; PUSAR reported further rescues on November 4 and November 6.
Deaths were reported by November 8; dangerous conditions were reported at Cobbett Row; services were closed along Imber Street and Cobbett Row; about 85 people were displaced from Cobbett Row.

Provincial Urban Search and Rescue deployed during the response; Nerridge Police later deployed in the city; assistance was provided in Cobbett Row; the tower crane and Aldan House were later reported restored.
The collapse destroyed Aldan House and its east wing, while requests for assistance were reported from Imber Street.
A warning was issued for Cobbett Row as Provincial Urban Search and Rescue deployed during the initial response.
Injuries were reported in Nerridge, and Nerridge fire service reported rescuing people later that morning.
PUSAR reported rescuing people on November 4 after its initial deployment to the collapse response.
PUSAR reported further rescues on November 6, while information was provided about the collapsed east wing.
By November 8, deaths were being reported in connection with the collapse and Nerridge Police had deployed in the city.
Safety updates said the west wing had not collapsed and the tower crane had not fallen.
Dangerous conditions and service closures were reported around Cobbett Row and Imber Street as about 85 people were displaced from Cobbett Row.
Assistance was provided in Cobbett Row during the later response.
Later on November 8, the tower crane and Aldan House were reported restored.
Deaths were reported in connection with the Aldan House collapse by November 8.
Injuries were confirmed and documented in Nerridge during the collapse response.

The tower crane at the site was reported not to have fallen.
Service at Aldan House was disrupted; later, services were reported closed along Imber Street and Cobbett Row.
